text: I will just call it trash because I only have access to 3 habits, others are premium (in fact it should be 0 stars)
author: Elkhadiri Asmaa
developer_reply: Thanks for trying HabStick. The free version supports up to 3 active habits, while Premium unlocks unlimited habits and other features. We keep the app completely ad-free, so subscriptions help support its development. We appreciate your feedback.

text: I don't like that there is a limit for none premium users of only 3 habits. Just set a price for the app from the get go and don't make tediously annoying subscriptions for "premium use" and advocate the app as "free" where effectively it is not.
author: Hamdi Ibn Haj ali
developer_reply: Thanks for the feedback. The app is free to use with a limited number of habits so people can try it without paying. Premium is optional for those who want more. I appreciate you sharing your thoughts.

author: Samuel Kaboré
developer_reply: Glad you love it. Thanks for the support.

text: hello ! would be nice if the habits that are only for certain days (e.g. tuesday and friday) keep their streak if during the days they aren’t performed (wed thu) it’d be like (tuesday streak one, friday streak 2, tuesday streak 3....etc) thank you !
author: Abderrahmane beddiar
developer_reply:
Thanks for explaining this clearly. That makes sense — for habits scheduled on specific days, streaks should respect only those days, not break in between.
I’m looking into improving streak logic for scheduled habits. Appreciate the thoughtful feedback.
